ladder.label: TOPPING
ladder.why: Daily momentum just crossed down and price lost its 10-day average mid-cycle.
ladder.next: Trim or tighten stops; next likely support is the daily-cycle timing band (~day 36-42, now day 24).

ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum just crossed up; investor cycle failed (broke its start low) (investor cycle week 13 · failed · daily cycle day 24).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): topping. Bigger picture (no clear trend): mixed.
points: Bigger picture is mixed (no clear trend for a daily long)

entry.text: Momentum rolled over and the 10-day average is lost — reduce or tighten stops.

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 24 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 24 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日

ladder.why_zh: 日线动量刚刚向下交叉，且价格在周期中段失守 10 日均线。

ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：做顶中。大局（趋势不明）：混合。
points_zh: 大局为混合（对日线多头而言属趋势不明）

ladder.liq_line: US net liquidity is neutral right now — no macro tilt either way on the odds.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ TOPPING signal triggered 1 trading day ago (~2026-06-18), switching from NEARING A LOW. Signal strength: moderate (score -40/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 做顶中信号于 1 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-18），自接近低点切换而来。 信号强度：中等（评分 -40/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：强卖出/离场形态（-63）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

description.summary: Colliers International Group Inc. provides commercial real estate, engineering, and investment management solutions in the United States, Canada, Europe, Australia, the United Kingdom, Poland, China, India, and internationally. The company offers capital markets services for property sales, debt finance, mortgage investment banking, and landlord and tenant representation services; and outsourcing services, such as building operations and maintenance, facilities management, lease administration, property accounting and financial reporting, contract and construction management, valuation and appraisal review and management, portfolio or single asset valuation, financial reporting advisory, arbitration consulting, research, highest and best use studies, property tax reviews, appeals and litigation support, and occupier services, as well as loan servicing. It also engages in the planning, designing, and project management of assets, including bridges and structure, highway and traffic engineering, construction engineering and inspection, water, traffic planning, and rail; and provision of air quality assessments, brownfield redevelopment, environmental impact assessments, ground water resource development, site remediation, noise studies, land development and monitoring, and other services, as well as water, storm, and wastewater management services. In addition, the company offers project management services, which include bid document review, construction monitoring and delivery management, contract administration and integrated cost control, development management, facility and engineering functionality, milestone and performance monitoring, quality assurance, risk management and strategic project consulting; and perpetual funds, long-dated funds, and separately managed accounts. Colliers International Group Inc. was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
